{
  "thinking": "Draft looks buildable: two lines from the tail, start angles about 75 degrees apart, which is fine. The only weak spot is the sharp kink where the back line turns up into the neck. Review it, then dry run once it's locked.",
  "review": "Nice, I like it. Two lines from the tail leave START about 75 degrees apart, so that's fine, and no floating bits. One fix: where the upper line comes off the back and turns up into the neck, the corner is too tight. Round it into a smooth sweep, a bit more room before it heads up, or the fall stops there. Same on the head: keep the turn into the beak soft. The two lines meeting at the beak tip is fine. If you can, make the neck a touch longer and more S-shaped so it reads swan, not duck. Otherwise good to lock. Sofia and I can take one line each, and I'll take the start.",

  "notes": "Reviewed Hana's swan: told her to soften the neck-base corner and beak turn. After lock: one person per line (stroke 1 leaves START), dry_run once built. Watch for bumps if two work within 3 units."
